policy_question: Can source/positive/schema cases with missing checker be migrated as checker_missing_manual_review_required?
recommended_decision: do_not_unlock_in_batch; checker remains a minimum package-core asset for wave004 canonical package creation
conditions: A future separately authorized skeleton-package policy would be required; current wave004 should not create packages with no checker.
notes: This preserves checker-governed benchmark semantics and avoids paper-facing ambiguity.

policy_question: Can cases with source/positive/checker but no safe retained evidence be migrated with evidence_not_retained?
recommended_decision: already_allowed_only_when package core is complete and evidence boundary is explicit; no additional unlock here
conditions: source.sql, positive.sql, checker, clear pool/case_id, README template, package_validation_summary schema, provenance, and denominator boundary metadata must be present.
notes: Wave002 policy already allows evidence_not_retained; current blockers are checker/manual/orphan rather than only missing retained evidence.

policy_question: Can static-inferred hard negatives be accepted as needs_review for non-Common-core backlog packages?
recommended_decision: manual_review_required_before_unlock; keep non-paper-facing needs_review label available only after human semantic/checker approval
conditions: Human review must confirm the negative role can be represented without paper-facing approval and without changing case_sets or denominators.
notes: Six core-complete manual rows could be reviewed next, but this packet does not batch-approve them.

policy_question: Can packages with partial schema assets be migrated if schema status is marked partial_schema_manual_review_required?
recommended_decision: manual_review_only; do not unlock if checker/package core is incomplete
conditions: Partial schema can be documented only after checker/core assets are present and public README/package-validation caveats are explicit.
notes: Schema gaps occur with checker/core gaps in current manual rows, so no batch unlock is safe.

policy_question: Can orphan/unregistered cases be standardized before registry reconciliation?
recommended_decision: do_not_unlock; require separate registry reconciliation preview first
conditions: Resolve case_id/pool/provenance and preview registry reconciliation before any package creation.
notes: This avoids creating public packages for identities not reconciled to governance records.

policy_question: Can local-path evidence be archive-mapped without copying raw content?
recommended_decision: keep existing guardrail; archive-map or exclude only, never copy raw local-path/log/trace artifacts
conditions: No raw stdout/stderr/debug logs, prompt/token/API/model traces, or unsanitized local-path artifacts may enter public packages.
notes: Public hygiene guardrail is necessary but not sufficient to unlock rows with missing checker or registry blockers.

policy_question: What minimum asset set is required for wave004 package creation?
recommended_decision: require source.sql, positive.sql, checker, clear pool/case_id, provenance, denominator boundary metadata, README template, package_validation_summary schema, and safe evidence mapping
conditions: No source/positive relaxation; no case_sets/denominator/report/result/paper/metric changes; fail closed on ambiguity.
notes: This codifies the fail-closed package-core threshold for future blocker work.
